description: Punjabi-centred, connected and plural historical anthology. About seven centuries; not a verified continuous genealogy or one unchanged political unit.
rules: No religion-based prowess or betrayal statistics
No asserted uniform Muslim identity for every early Khokhar chief
No glorification filter: conflicts and contested accounts remain attributed
No future protagonist instantiated in the childhood chapter
No playable claim merely from a plan entry
